result.summary: Independently re-ran all 5 REQ-007 acceptance criteria against current branch head (0c8746a), after ORCH's two post-TEST-RUNNER fix commits (a0e9760, 0c8746a) that untracked an accidentally-committed apps/web/.next/ and widened .gitignore to **/.next/ + **/out/. AC1: `ls apps/web/{package.json,next.config.ts,tsconfig.json,eslint.config.mjs,next-env.d.ts}` and `ls -d apps/web/{src,messages,public}` all resolved; the same 7 paths at repo root (`src messages public next.config.ts tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs next-env.d.ts`) all errored 'No such file or directory' (exit 2, expected). AC2: root package.json contains exactly `"private": true` and `"workspaces": ["apps/*"]`; `npm run build` from repo root exited 0 (Compiled successfully, TypeScript finished clean, 4 routes generated, no Cannot find module/Module not found/error TS); `npm run lint` exited 0 with only the 2 pre-existing @next/next/no-img-element warnings, 0 errors. AC3: started `npm run start` from repo root, waited synchronously for '✓ Ready' in the server's own log (no fixed sleep), then curl'd all 4 locales — /ru->lang="ru", /uz->lang="uz", /en->lang="en", /kk->lang="kk", 0 MISSING_MESSAGE/IntlError matches across all 4 bodies — and /health returned exactly 200; killed the actual listening PID via netstat afterward and confirmed teardown (subsequent curl: exit 7 / http_code 000, connection refused). AC4: `ls apps/web/messages/` listed exactly en.json/kk.json/ru.json/uz.json; re-ran the spec's Node key-set-diff script verbatim — output ru_count=177, uz/en/kk_count=177 missing=[] extra=[] for all three, character-for-character match to spec. AC5: `git log --oneline --follow -- apps/web/src/i18n/routing.ts` shows 4 commits: the move commit plus the 3 pre-migration commits (Kazakh, English, ru/uz+next-intl foundation), confirming git tracked a real rename, not delete+add. Separately verified the branch cleanup itself: `git status --short` is clean of build artifacts (only this handoff's own edit dirty), `git ls-files | grep -iE '(^|/)(\.next|out)/'` returns 0 tracked matches repo-wide, and rebuilding fresh (`npm run build`) reproduced apps/web/.next/ as untracked-and-ignored (git status stayed clean after the rebuild) — the .gitignore fix in a0e9760 genuinely works, not just claimed. Confirmed docs/issues/ISS-0004.yaml's 'resolved' status is accurate: its description names the exact mechanism (root-anchored /.next/ missing apps/web/.next/) and the exact fix (added **/.next/ and **/out/, kept existing entries, git rm --cached the stray tree) that a0e9760's diff shows verbatim — same issue TEST-RUNNER rediscovered during Step 4, not a new one, and now genuinely closed by the code, not just by the label. All 5 ACs re-derived from real command output on the current HEAD, none copied from test-reports/report-2026-09-06-WF02-REQ-007.yaml.
